_readme: Baseball's key dates, shared by every calendar (#42): Schedule (tag schedule: markers on the calendar), Cleanup (cleanup), Hardball's timeline (hardball) and the Draft page (draft). Each entry has a stable id (kind-year). Entries with from: 'api' are MLB's season dates as first announced. The site merges in MLB's current dates live (src/scripts/keyDates.js, re-checked often in the offseason and rarely in season) and shows 'moved from' when they differ, adds seasons MLB has scheduled and drops entries 45 days past; `npm run refresh-key-dates` writes the same changes into this file. The rest are hand-curated with a source and updated from the news. A date that moves keeps the old one in `history` [{date, dateEnd?, recorded, source}], and the pages show 'moved from'. `status` is 'postponed' or 'canceled' when that's what happened (default: scheduled). Optional: time (Eastern, HH:MM), dateText + sort for a date without a fixed day, teamNotes keyed by team id, link ('hardball'), hardballDetail/hardballSource for Hardball's timeline.

dates.title: World Series ends
dates.detail: The offseason starts the next day. Players with expiring contracts become free agents, but for five days they can re-sign only with their own team.

dates.title: Free agency opens
dates.detail: Day 5 after the World Series, about 5 p.m. ET: free agents can sign anywhere. Same deadline for contract options and qualifying offers ($23.15 million this year).

dates.title: Qualifying offer decisions
dates.detail: 4 p.m. ET: players who received a qualifying offer ($23.15 million for one year) must accept or reject it.

teamNotes.110: Trevor Rogers has to decide whether to take the Orioles' qualifying offer.

source.label: MLB Trade Rumors: Eight players receive qualifying offers

dates.title: Rule 5 protection deadline
dates.detail: 6 p.m. ET: teams add prospects to the 40-man roster to protect them from the Rule 5 Draft.

dates.title: Tender deadline
dates.detail: 5 p.m. ET: teams must offer contracts to arbitration-eligible and pre-arbitration players or let them become free agents.

source.label: MLB Trade Rumors: The 2026-27 offseason begins

dates.title: CBA expires
dates.detail: 11:59 p.m. ET. A lockout would freeze major-league signings and trades: see Hardball.
dates.hardballDetail: 11:59 p.m. ET. The old terms can stay in place while talks go on, but either side can act: owners can lock out the players, or players can strike.

dates.title: Rule 5 Draft
dates.detail: The last day of the Winter Meetings.

dates.title: Salary arbitration figures exchanged
dates.detail: Teams and arbitration-eligible players swap salary figures; hearings follow if they don't settle.

dates.title: International signing period opens
dates.detail: Teams can start signing international amateur players.

dates.title: Pitchers and catchers report
dates.detail: Each team sets its own date.

dates.title: Opening Day
dates.detail: The season opener is March 24 (a Netflix game); most teams open March 25.
